title: langquant: a scaffold-as-state research artifact testing whether a refreshing language scaffold can serve as the sole working state for a stateless LLM
description: langquant is a scaffold-as-state research artifact that tests whether a fixed-structure, per-turn-refreshed natural-language scaffold can serve as the sole working state for a stateless LLM, with no conversation history in context. In a local A/B experiment (qwen3.5:9b main model, qwen3.5:4b state extractor, 20 turns, n=1 per condition), the model maintained recall and caught contradictions while seeing only the scaffold plus the current message; information-theoretic analysis reports transfer entropy of 0.085 bits for the compressed scaffold (vs 0.608 naked), interpreted as the scaffold approximating a Markov state. The repo's own Caveats section scopes these as preliminary (n=1, 20 turns, extractor paraphrase drift, scaffold not yet hard-clamped to a fixed budget).
